parameters.query: SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '8s'; WITH claimed AS (SELECT * FROM public.v3_claim_delivery_attempts(100,NOW())) SELECT a.attempt_id,a.opportunity_id,a.capture_event_id,a.routing_tier AS expected_tier,a.target_agent_id,a.target_number,a.lease_token,a.status,a.provider_accepted_at,a.requested_at FROM claimed a JOIN public.lead_routing_opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id=a.opportunity_id JOIN public.i24_capture_events e ON e.capture_event_id=a.capture_event_id WHERE public.v3_day_allowed(a.capture_event_id,a.opportunity_id,NULL) AND a.delivery_kind='offer' AND a.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.v3_enabled IS TRUE AND o.assigned_agent_id IS NULL AND o.current_delivery_attempt_id=a.attempt_id AND o.routing_tier=a.routing_tier AND COALESCE(a.provider_accepted_at,a.requested_at)+INTERVAL '2 minutes' <= NOW() UNION ALL SELECT a.attempt_id,a.opportunity_id,a.capture_event_id,a.routing_tier AS expected_tier,a.target_agent_id,a.target_number,a.lease_token,a.status,a.provider_accepted_at,a.requested_at FROM public.lead_routing_delivery_attempts a JOIN public.lead_routing_opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id=a.opportunity_id JOIN public.i24_capture_events e ON e.capture_event_id=a.capture_event_id WHERE public.v3_day_allowed(a.capture_event_id,a.opportunity_id,NULL) AND a.delivery_kind='offer' AND a.status='sent' AND a.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.v3_enabled IS TRUE AND o.assigned_agent_id IS NULL AND o.current_delivery_attempt_id=a.attempt_id AND o.routing_tier=a.routing_tier AND COALESCE(a.provider_accepted_at,a.requested_at)+INTERVAL '2 minutes' <= NOW() UNION ALL SELECT a.attempt_id,a.opportunity_id,a.capture_event_id,a.routing_tier AS expected_tier,a.target_agent_id,a.target_number,a.lease_token,a.status,a.provider_accepted_at,a.requested_at FROM public.lead_routing_delivery_attempts a JOIN public.lead_routing_opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id=a.opportunity_id JOIN public.i24_capture_events e ON e.capture_event_id=a.capture_event_id WHERE public.v3_day_allowed(a.capture_event_id,a.opportunity_id,NULL) AND a.delivery_kind='offer' AND a.status='delivered' AND a.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.v3_enabled IS TRUE AND o.assigned_agent_id IS NULL AND o.current_delivery_attempt_id=a.attempt_id AND o.routing_tier=a.routing_tier AND COALESCE(o.expires_at,a.delivered_at+INTERVAL '5 minutes') <= NOW();

nodes.notes: WF23 is the sole delivery-timeout scheduler; WF3c owns the transition.

parameters.query: SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '8s'; WITH claimed AS (SELECT * FROM public.claim_v3_assigned_notices(100,NOW())) SELECT a.*,a.target_number AS number,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'lead_name',''),NULLIF(c.lead_name,''),'No disponible') AS lead_name,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'lead_phone',''),NULLIF(c.lead_phone,''),NULLIF(o.e164_phone,''),'No disponible') AS lead_phone,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'property_title',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'property',''),NULLIF(c.current_property,''),NULLIF(o.property_id,''),'No disponible') AS property_title,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'operation_type',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'operation',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'listing_type',''),'No disponible') AS operation_type,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'property_zone',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'zone',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'address',''),'No disponible') AS property_zone,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'property_price',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'price',''),'No disponible') AS property_price,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.property_public_id,''),NULLIF(o.property_id,''),'No disponible') AS property_public_id,e.offer_context->>'easybroker_url' AS easybroker_url FROM claimed a JOIN public.i24_capture_events e ON e.capture_event_id=a.capture_event_id JOIN public.lead_routing_opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id=a.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN public.conversations c ON c.conversation_id=o.conversation_id WHERE public.v3_day_allowed(a.capture_event_id,a.opportunity_id,NULL);
SELECT *, reason AS alert_kind, 'day_deadline_missed' AS state, 'Revisar etapa detenida; no reofertar automaticamente' AS required_action FROM public.v3_day_claim_alerts();

UPDATE public.v3_day_incidents SET notification_state=CASE WHEN NULLIF($3::text,'') IS NOT NULL THEN 'accepted' ELSE 'unknown' END,provider_message_id=NULLIF($3::text,''),notified_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE capture_event_id=$1::bigint AND notification_token=$2::uuid AND notification_state='claimed' RETURNING capture_event_id,notification_state;
